observation.visible_scene: The excerpt contains two distinct shots joined by a cross-dissolve. Shot 1 (frames 1-15): a man-made whitewater channel where a person in a red life jacket and silver helmet is in the water immediately beside a yellow-framed structure (curved yellow struts/legs) topped by a flat white mattress-like pad; a yellow paddle blade protrudes at the structure's upper-left, blue floating blocks sit in the lower-left foreground and against the far concrete wall, and a sponsor banner hangs along the wall. Shot 2 (frames 24-41): a wider view of the same venue showing a metal footbridge packed with spectators and staff, a large video screen at upper right, an inclined launch ramp whose end dips into the water, and an orange inflatable raft with helmeted paddlers at the ramp foot; the left bank wall reads 'RAPIDS'.
visible_changes: In shot 1 the person and the yellow structure remain roughly co-located, drifting slowly with the churning water; only small relative shifts occur and the person stays at the structure's right side throughout.

A cross-dissolve begins around frame 16 and completes by about frame 23: the close view of the person and yellow structure fades out while the wide bridge/ramp view fades in, the two images superimposing during the overlap (an editing transition, not physical motion).

In shot 2 the orange raft moves away from the ramp foot out into the open water, its occupants holding/paddling with yellow-bladed paddles; the raft's position relative to the ramp changes from resting at the ramp end to being free in the current.
The large screen in shot 2 continuously displays an image of a raft on a ramp (a replay/loop), separate from the live raft in the water.
The framing of shot 2 gradually reveals more of the left 'RAPIDS' wall and the foreground blue blocks over time, consistent with a slight camera pan/zoom-out.
Persistent across each shot: the yellow structure with white top and the red-clad person (shot 1); the bridge, crowd, screen, ramp and orange raft (shot 2).
outside_clip_unknowns: What caused the person in shot 1 to be in the water beside the structure (capsize, obstacle, rescue) is not shown.
The fate of the person after the dissolve and the outcome of the raft run in shot 2 are outside the segment.
Whether the screen image corresponds to the live raft or a prior run is not established here.
uncertain_details: Exact identity/function of the yellow-and-white object (overturned craft, obstacle, or fixture) is not determinable.
Precise direction and magnitude of camera motion in shot 2 (pan vs zoom vs both) is inferred only from changing framing.
The exact frame boundaries of the cross-dissolve are approximate.
Small drifts of the person/structure in shot 1 may be partly current-induced rather than self-propelled.
